learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic theoretical foundations of intelligent systems with the greatest potential in industry.
Understand their usefulness and impact on industrial production systems, and be able to evaluate their necessity in specific applications.
Design and implement intelligent industrial systems using appropriate technology.

syllabus_topics: Applications: estimation and classification; intelligent modeling, control and supervision; others.
teaching_methods: Oral presentation and defense of project
assessment_rules: For ordinary and extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as: Note final = (0.50 × T) + (0.10 × EC) + (0.40 × EX). To pass, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for the course project (T) and the final exam (EX). If these minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. In case of doubt about the authorship of an evaluable test, a face-to-face defense may be requested.
